newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close lower as Wall Street retreats.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close lower as Wall Street retreats.

text.p: UK shares dropped on Wednesday, reversing Tuesday's gains as a second day of declines on Wall Street took the steam out of bourses across Europe.

The FTSE 100 index closed down 16.3 points at 4,045.2, with decliners in a seven-to-three majority. British Aerospace dropped as Frence suspended the sale of Thomson, while Cable & Wireless fell amid switching into British Telecom.

Traders said UK stocks had been insulated from the worst effects of the Dow's overnight 1.2 percent tumble by signs that sterling's recent surge had run its course, though currency turmoil continued to unsettle the market.
